title: Identify all TSC Analysis Services offerors, award sequence and personnel — depth 4
summary: Recover bidder, source-selection, bridge, corrective-action, transaction and key-personnel records across BAE orders 15F06725F0001209 and 15F06725F0001838 and later IntelliWare order 15F06726F0000362.

sources.title: BAE beats out 6 to win $129M FBI Terrorist Screening Center Analysis Services contract

data.target: FBI TSC Analysis Services offeror, award-sequence and contract-personnel reconstruction
data.research_question: Who were all offerors, what action changed the awardee from BAE to IntelliWare, and who proposed and performs each contract?
hypotheses: USAspending transactions expose a deobligation sequence around the later award.
Protest or corrective-action files explain the change in awardee.
Unsuccessful-offeror notices or source-selection records identify the six unnamed competitors.
Subcontract and key-personnel records identify the BAE and IntelliWare teams.
objectives: Obtain the solicitation and all amendments.
Collect complete transaction histories for all three award records.
Obtain protest, corrective-action, cancellation, termination and transition records.
Obtain the offer-receipt logs and identify every offeror.
Obtain BAE and IntelliWare key-personnel and subcontract records.
Cross-match every confirmed company and person against FBI-TSC-AIE response records.
